rationale: M7.4 first available component yielded 148/160 young 3-monomer two-edge chains (median t2); select on pre-fork source size and edge age in independent new seeds.
question: Does chemical-bond conduction favor coherent growth or original-edge preservation of the SAME native partly aged 5-16-member bonded cohort compared with matched no-transfer forks?

design.source_simulation: Original M7.3 no_transfer world; 264 native particles, 24x24 periodic, movement_cost=1, 16 dispersed sources generating 32 energy/tick, no catalysis, zero initial bonds.
design.independent_unit: One numeric seed, at most one selected naturally formed source; matched forks not independent units.

selection.component: At a post-step tick, first eligible maximal bonded connected component; 5<=particle count<=16, >=4 native original bonds, at least one member with spare native valence.
selection.mature_edge: At least two currently existing different original material pair edges must each have age >=20 consecutive observed post-step snapshots, resetting age after any native break event even when same pair re-forms within that tick.
selection.rule: From tick1 to tick500 update material edge ages using native break event recorder plus present edges. From tick120 choose first eligible component and lowest sorted member-ID tuple within the tick. Never use future outcomes. 20-tick old edges show aged substructure, NOT guaranteed continuous identity of entire component.
selection.absent: Retain null seed; no adaptive extension or replacement.

measurements.source: At fork save original material IDs, original material edge pairs and their individual edge ages, total size, cyclomatic number, spare-valence members and energy.
measurements.fork: Three exact clones of full world (positions, per-particle and bond energies, source buffers, total counters, RNG fingerprint/draws); no added atoms, bonds or sources.
measurements.intact: No native BREAK event on any original edge through t120, including same-tick reformation.
measurements.coherent_growth: At t120 same native connected component contains all original IDs plus at least one external ID. Also record ever growth and duration.
measurements.incident_formations: Native FORM event with precisely one endpoint among original cohort IDs, distinguishing any event before first original edge loss.
measurements.reclosure: After original edge lost, full original material edge set present again (not necessarily functional repair).
measurements.energy_flux: Count accepted transfers on original intact pair edges, other present source-internal edges, incoming across source boundary, outgoing across source boundary, within remaining world; total particle energy conserved.
measurements.source_energy: Energy in original cohort particle IDs and number with enough energy for chemical new-bond formation at fork and predefined checkpoints; IDs persist if network fragments.
measurements.whole_world: Track global new bonds separately from incident source formations.
measurements.direct_control: Exactly identical native original-edge BREAK sets at t1 in all matched arms; no-transfer sham direct 120-step clone for first selected seed per shard.
measurements.physics_control: Verify energy flux tracker gives exact same state as M7.3 original transport on synthetic and native source snapshots and is RNG-free.
measurements.ledgers: At fixed checkpoints for every fork, sum stored+dissipated+unabsorbed==configured_initial+injected.

gates.primary_growth: Require >=40 selected independent seeds AND >=25 discordant growth outcomes bond_only vs no_transfer at EXACTLY t120, with >=2/3 of discordant pairs favoring bond_only. Otherwise not_met_or_underpowered.
gates.secondary_original_survival: Require >=40 selected and >=25 discordant outcomes for native original edge survival through t120, with >=2/3 favoring bond_only. Otherwise not_met_or_underpowered.
gates.descriptive_strata: Tree vs cyclic and size5-8 vs size9-16 are exploratory stratification only, no change of main gate.
